title: Pallaburusu
plot_overview: A 70-year-old widower asks his son to buy a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to complete this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like compact, character-driven comedies about family friction and everyday misunderstandings; Not for you if you prefer action, romance, or heavily detailed plots.
review_summary: Pros: comic family tension; relatable premise; escalating mishaps | Cons: limited context; no review consensus
